verdict.rationale: Brave Search API is a search and data API, not an agent or AI host. Plugging in MCP servers so the product can use their tools is the MCP-client role, which is a category error for this kind of product. The evidence shows only the opposite role: an official Brave Search MCP server that other agents like Claude Desktop connect to. That server-side evidence belongs to a different story and does not make the client axis applicable.
